''See also: [[Truegold Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|Truegold represents the highest tier within the [[Gold]] [[advancement]] stage of the [[sacred arts]], positioned above [[Highgold]] and below the realm of [[Underlord]]. Reaching this level requires immense effort, as the progression gaps between [[Gold]] stages are significantly larger than those found in lower ranks like [[Copper]] or [[Iron]]. Achieving Truegold status signifies that a practitioner has gained complete control over the [[Remnant]] in their core, often resulting in a sense of spiritual completeness. While Truegolds are powerful enough to serve as squad leaders, clan chiefs, or elite elders, they remain vastly inferior to [[Underlord|Underlords]], who possess unique abilities like [[soulfire|Soulfire]]. The transition from Truegold to [[Underlord]] is exceptionally rare, with only one in ten thousand practitioners successfully making the leap. Because of this difficulty, Truegolds often spend much of their lives at this stage. The level is also characterized by varying degrees of mastery; older Truegolds may possess superior, highly practiced techniques compared to younger ones, though the latter are often more respected due to their potential for further [[advancement]]. Additionally, reaching this rank can be influenced by one's physical and spiritual foundation, as a lack of proper preparation in the body or soul can prevent successful [[advancement]] beyond this stage.}}

== Soulsmith ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-02-soulsmith|Truegold represents a specific rank of [[Gold]] that sits above the level of [[Highgold]]. As a stage of [[advancement]] and a power stage, it serves as the realm that immediately precedes [[Underlord]]. This peak stage can be attained by [[Iron]] practitioners who are either particularly gifted or fortunate. Ultimately, Truegold is recognized as a rank or title, a status noted by [[Jai Long]].}}

== Skysworn ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-04-skysworn|Truegold represents a specific stage of power and [[madra]] potency that is characterized by its craftiness. While most assassins only reach this level at best, the rank is held by individuals such as [[Jai Long]] and [[Renfei|Pai Ren]]. Within the progression of [[sacred artists]], it is a level that [[Lindon]] might achieve ten years after reaching [[Highgold]]. Despite its significance, [[Yerin]] considers Truegold to be the least impressive rank among the [[sacred artists]] she has encountered.}}

== Ghostwater ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-05-ghostwater|Truegolds are powerful presences that are sent to [[Ghostwater]] every ten years for the purpose of training. While a young woman possessing [[Blood Shadow]] holds this rank, it is noted that older Truegolds often surpass their younger counterparts due to more practiced techniques. Although [[Lowgold|Lowgolds]] are capable of defeating them, the rank is significant enough that an oracle can be raised to this level. During certain events, a Truegold [[aura]] has flared in the distance, and the [[Highgold]] also holds this status. Additionally, the [[Underlady]] is accompanied by Truegolds that possess appearances resembling a cross between humans and [[dragons]].}}

== Underlord ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|As a rank within the [[Skysworn]], Truegold status allows individuals like [[Mercy]] to maintain their position. During a naval engagement, Truegolds utilized defensive [[scripts]] and techniques to protect their ship, demonstrating that they possess enough power to stand up to [[Underlord|Underlords]]. One such warrior, clad in green armor with bright yellow spikes sweeping from her shoulders, fought enemies using a [[sword]] in each hand. While advancing to [[Underlord]] is considered superior because it remakes the body and [[spirit]], reaching the peak of Truegold was a necessary condition for [[Lindon]] to drink a remaining [[elixirs|elixir]]. Additionally, [[Akura Charity]] observed that the [[Seishen Kingdom]] had trained their Truegolds effectively, and members of this rank are granted access to the hospitals within the capital city.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">10</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Lindon]] can drink the remaining [[elixirs|elixir]] once [[Yerin]] reaches the peak of [[Truegold]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c3" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|A [[Truegold]] in green armor faced their enemies with a [[sword]] in each of her hands and bright yellow spikes sweeping forward from her shoulders.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c9">''Underlord'', chapter 9</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Yerin]] cycled her [[Truegold]] [[madra]].<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c10">''Underlord'', chapter 10</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=cradle-06-underlord|[[Truegold|Truegolds]] and children of large clans are permitted into the hospitals within the capital city.<ref name="cradle-06-underlord-c12">''Underlord'', chapter 12</ref>}}</li>
